summary.zh: agent-pack 支持把声明为 project 的 MCP 写到 Claude 项目级存储：默认 local（~/.claude.json 里该项目路径下，写前备份、保持权限、失败回滚），或用 --project-store file 写项目根 .mcp.json（含机器路径的条目被拒绝）。目标不可写或结构无法识别时跳过并警告，不回退写用户级。
summary.en: agent-pack can write MCP servers declared project-level to Claude's project stores: local by default (under the project's path in ~/.claude.json, backed up first, permissions kept, rolled back on failure) or, with --project-store file, the project's .mcp.json (entries tied to this machine are refused). An unwritable or unrecognized target is skipped with a warning, never written to the user level instead.
